shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books in my free time.
Cooking is one of my favorite hobbies.
Traveling helps me learn about new cultures.
I usually exercise in the morning before work.
Listening to music improves my mood greatly.
Learning a new language can be challenging but rewarding.
I often visit local museums to appreciate art and history.
Gardening is a relaxing activity that connects me with nature.
Attending workshops is a great way to develop new skills and meet people.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about volunteering.
questions: Q1: Can you share your experience with volunteering?
Q2: What challenges did you face while volunteering?
Q3: What is your opinion about the importance of volunteering in the community?
Q4: What advice would you give to someone considering volunteering for the first time?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about eco-friendly living.
questions: Q1: What steps do you take to live an eco-friendly lifestyle?
Q2: What are some difficulties you encounter in maintaining these habits?
Q3: How do you feel about the impact of individual actions on the environment?
Q4: What recommendations would you make to someone who wants to be more eco-friendly?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about hobbies and interests.
questions: Q1: What hobbies do you enjoy in your spare time?
Q2: How do you prioritize your hobbies alongside work or study?
Q3: Why do you think having hobbies is important for personal well-being?
Q4: What advice would you give to someone looking for a new hobby?
